purpose: Force real actuation of Portfolio + Projection + Shared Proof DAG + Interface Width on fresh geometries where the first mixed holdout was dominated by immediate relation closure.
architecture_under_test: N-only exact relation node retained when nonterminal
M2R capability-bound retrieval and replay before every base attempt

strong_baselines.BSGS_PORTFOLIO: same four fixed bases, cumulative work until factor
strong_baselines.RHO_PORTFOLIO: same four fixed bases, cumulative work until factor

frozen_gates.criterion: all promoted certificates replay and all returned factors are exact nontrivial divisors
at least 10 of 12 cases survive relation discovery without a terminal factor and therefore expose the portfolio layer
among exposed cases, at least 80% record capability-matched M2R reuse on every actually attempted base
among exposed cases, at least 60% emit at least one exact COLLISION_TO_ORDER_DIVIDES projection
UFK factors at least 50% of exposed cases
no cap bypass; OPEN remains non-negative and includes immutable frontier/capability receipt
median UFK/strong-baseline arithmetic work <= 1.0 among mutually successful exposed cases

verdict_policy.PASS_ARCHITECTURE_ACTUATED__NOT_COST_COM: H1-H6 and H8 pass but H7 fails
verdict_policy.REFUTED_PORTFOLIO_ACTUATION: H1 passes but H2/H3/H4/H6 fails without explicit resource UNKNOWN
verdict_policy.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT: frozen scope cannot complete because of explicit resource limit
verdict_policy.CERTIFICATE_FAILURE: any promoted exact certificate fails replay
